installation_questions.question: Select the daytime speed rate
installation_questions.description: The lower this number is, the longer each day will last. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the nighttime speed rate
installation_questions.description: The lower this number is, the longer each night will last. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select an Experience Multiplier
installation_questions.description: The Higher this number is, the faster EXP will be gained. The Normal range is 0.1 - 20

installation_questions.question: Select a Pal capture rate
installation_questions.description: The higher this number is, the greater your chance of capturing a Pal is. The Normal Range is 0.5 - 2

installation_questions.question: Select the Pal appearance rate
installation_questions.description: This setting effects game performance. The higher this number is, the more Pals that will spawn. The Normal Range is 0.5 - 3

installation_questions.question: Select the damage from Pals multiplier
installation_questions.description: The lower this number is, the less damage you and your Pals will take from wild Pals during combat. Also decreases the damage output of your Pals. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the damage to Pals multiplier
installation_questions.description: The higher this number is, the more damage you and your Pals will do to wild Pals during combat. Also increases the damage your Pals receive. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the Pal hunger depletion rate
installation_questions.description: The lower this number is, the longer it will take for your Pals to get hungry. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the Pal stamina depletion rate
installation_questions.description: The lower this number is, the longer it will take for your Pals stamina to run out. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the Pal auto HP regeneration rate
installation_questions.description: The higher this number is, the faster your Pal will recover health. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the Pal sleep HP regeneration rate
installation_questions.description: The higher this number is, the faster your Pal will recover health when inside the Palbox. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the damage multiplier of players
installation_questions.description: The higher this number is, the greater the damage output of your character. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the damage multiplier to players

installation_questions.question: Select the player hunger depletion rate
installation_questions.description: The lower this number is, the longer it will take for your character to get hungry. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the player stamina depletion rate
installation_questions.description: The lower this number is, the longer it will take for your character to run out of stamina. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the player auto HP regeneration rate
installation_questions.description: The higher this number is, the faster your character will recover health. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Select the player sleep HP regeneration rate
installation_questions.description: The higher this number is, the faster your character will recover health when sleeping. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5

installation_questions.question: Set the HP multiplier for structures
installation_questions.description: The higher this number the more health structures will have

installation_questions.question: Select the Damage to structure multiplier
installation_questions.description: The lower this number is, the less damage your structures and builds will take. The Normal Range is 0.5 - 3

installation_questions.question: Select the structure deterioration rate

installation_questions.description: The lower this number is, the faster objects/resources like rocks will respawn after mining. The Normal Range is 0.5 - 3

installation_questions.question: Select the dropped item multiplier
installation_questions.description: The higher this number is, the more items/materials you will receive when defeating a Pal. The Normal Range is 0.5 - 3

installation_questions.question: Select the work speed Multiplier
installation_questions.description: The higher this number is, the faster pals work. The Normal Range is 0.1 - 5
